\problemname{Guess}

Find a hidden number from $1$ to $n$.

\section*{Input}
The first line contains $n$ ($1 \le n \le 10^6$).

\section*{Output}
Print \texttt{? x} to learn whether the hidden number is smaller (\texttt{<}), larger (\texttt{>}) or equal (\texttt{=}) to $x$, and \texttt{! x} to answer.
